findings.current: Hidden in the darkness just ten feet away

findings.defect: One jang is approximately ten feet, not an arm’s length.

findings.current: Having lost control of the conversation in an instant, Jeong Hogun could only follow him away, his face rigid as a rock.
findings.defect: The draft reverses who follows whom.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly says he follows Jeong Hogun.
findings.replacement: Having lost control of the conversation in an instant, he could only leave with his face rigid as a rock, following Jeong Hogun.

findings.current: he was interrogating the Embroidered Uniform Guard soldiers who’d neglected their duty.

findings.current: perhaps you didn’t want to serve in the Embroidered Uniform Guard at all?
findings.rationale: Jeong names 금위군, not his own 금의위.
findings.replacement: perhaps you didn’t want to serve in the Imperial Guard at all?
findings.source: 금위군으로 복무하는 것 자체가 싫었던 건가?

findings.current: As of today, you are no longer members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
findings.defect: Misidentifies the force from which Jeong purports to dismiss them.
findings.rationale: His attempted dismissal of Imperial Guard soldiers is the jurisdictional issue Ma Sanbao challenges.
findings.replacement: As of today, you are no longer members of the Imperial Guard.

findings.replacement: I fervently cheered on the middle-aged reservists—I mean, the Imperial Guard soldiers

findings.current: Since when has the Embroidered Uniform Guard been able to dismiss its own guards on a whim?
findings.defect: “Its own guards” erases Ma Sanbao’s point that one organization is dismissing members of another.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly contrasts 금의위 and 금위군.
findings.replacement: Since when has the Embroidered Uniform Guard been able to dismiss Imperial Guard soldiers on a whim?
findings.source: 언제부터 금의위가 금위군의 해임을 그리 즉흥적으로 결정할 수 있었지?

findings.current: Not before leaving a stern warning for the two Embroidered Uniform Guard soldiers who’d escaped the threat of a surprise firing, though.
findings.defect: Again assigns the reprieved soldiers to the wrong guard force.
findings.replacement: Not before leaving a stern warning for the two Imperial Guard soldiers who’d escaped the threat of a surprise firing, though.
findings.source: 깜짝 해고 이벤트의 위기를 벗어난 두 금위군에게 엄중한 경고를 남기는 것을 잊지 않은 채.

findings.current: the remaining Embroidered Uniform Guard soldiers weren’t skilled enough to detect my presence.
findings.defect: Misidentifies the guards Jin judges unable to detect him.
findings.replacement: the remaining Imperial Guard soldiers weren’t skilled enough to detect my presence.

findings.current: I picked up a timely hint from a conversation between some other Embroidered Uniform Guard soldiers.

findings.current: a good old-fashioned brawl had become my only real specialty—and my sole extracurricular activity.
findings.defect: Turns the joke’s required general-education course into an extracurricular activity.
findings.rationale: 전공 and 교양 과목 contrast a major with a general-education course, not an optional extracurricular.
findings.replacement: a good old-fashioned brawl had become both my only major and my general-education requirement.

findings.current: Have some respect for the imperial family. They can’t treat people brought here for the grand banquet poorly just because they eat a little pork.
findings.defect: Changes an explanation of the imperial family’s need to save face into a rebuke of the listener.
findings.rationale: 황실 체면이 있지 supplies the reason they cannot turn the guests away.
findings.replacement: The imperial family has its reputation to consider. They can’t treat people brought here for the grand banquet poorly just because they eat a little pork.
findings.source: 황실 체면이 있지, 대연회를 위해 데려온 자들을 돼지고기 좀 먹는다고 박대할 수는 없지 않나.

findings.current: Who knew what they’d say now.
findings.defect: Makes Jin uncertain about their response rather than dryly observing that they would agree to anything now.
findings.rationale: The rhetorical question comments on their sudden obedience after narrowly avoiding dismissal.
findings.replacement: Of course they’d say yes now.

summary: The draft preserves the scene’s broad arc, but changes two distances, reverses who follows whom, and repeatedly conflates the Imperial Guard with the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
